row.title: DISCOVER-1: public by default, every system discoverable
row.body: Every live tenant is listed and cross-linked on ultrastable.io from the registries; seeded systems self-register daily via their public manifest; external listings are verified, rechecked daily and dropped on opt-out, noindex or 3 failures. Only ultrastable/ops stays private.
